title: Awesome_Mr_T's doors on stairs
description: This is a mod for Minecraft Java (26.1.2+) which allows you to place a door on the top end of straight stairs. Please see description for detailed information.
body:
This is a mod for Minecraft Java (26.1.x) which allows you to place a door on the top end of straight stairs.
For example, if stairs are facing north, the door in closed state will face south.
Placing a door on stairs corner pieces is not allowed.

Working for:
- Wooden and iron doors
- Single and double doors
